title: Umutima w'agaciro wabaza ubukuru
intro: Mu bitabo vy’ivya kera vya Korowani, hariho umuntu ubutunzi bwiwe n’ubumenyi bwiwe vyacitse inkuru z’imigani. Uwo mutima wavuye mw’isi ufise ibisharizo n’ubutunzi vyatangaje ababibona, yamara umutima wabo waravyishimiye kubera ubwibone. Twifatanye natwe uko dusobanura akabanga k’imwe mu nkuru za Korowani zigabisha cane, aho ubukuru bw’ibintu buhura n’iherezo ry’ukwicisha bugufi munsi y’ubutaka nyene bwavyaye ubutunzi bwabo.
clues: Navuye mw’isi nshizeko ibisharizo vyafata amaso y’abantu bose.
Nari mfise ubutunzi bwinshi cane be n’ubumenyi bwimbitse bwantandukanya n’abandi.
Igihe intumwa yaza ihamagara abantu kuri Allah, narabajije ubukuru bwabo n’ubwibone.
Abo bari bakikuje baranyonga ngo ubutoni bwa Allah atari bwo buva ku butunzi bwanje.
Abantu banje baratangajwe n’ubukuru bwanje, bipfuza ko noshikirwa n’ivyanje.
Ivyumba vyanje vyiza cane vyamizwe vyose mw’isi nk’igihano c’Imana.

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
